scope.summary: Run the export QA matrix per Section 13.27: all 8 archetypes x all seeded BXP- export profiles with EXPORT_BODY_VALID green per cell and the MT-624 round-trip harness executed on the ue_fbx_bridge and blender_gltf lanes for every archetype — extreme morphs (oversized cock, extreme tits) proven to survive delivery (REQ-044 as a standing matrix).
acceptance_criteria: The matrix exports every archetype through every seeded BXP- profile (usd behind its feature with typed skip); each cell's EXPORT_BODY_VALID report must be green — failures name the cell, check, and measured-vs-allowed values.

Round-trip verification (MT-624) runs for every archetype on ue_fbx_bridge and blender_gltf: morphs, skeleton, correctives, scale, and orientation survive; ARCH-F/G oversized-cock morphs and ARCH-A/B extreme-breast morphs are named survival checks.
Erection/gape dual-form export checks run on ARCH-F/G/H cells; the single-mesh weld lane is exercised on at least one archetype per sex configuration.
Budget breaches (blendshape counts, texture sizes, influence caps) fail cells typed rather than warning-and-passing.
Matrix results persist machine-readable as the packet's standing export evidence; CI long lane runs the full matrix, per-commit smoke runs ARCH-A x ue_fbx_bridge.
scope.risk_if_missed: Export works for the demo body and breaks on production extremes — the Daz-bridge failure pattern exactly — with the breakage discovered inside Blender/UE where diagnosis is slowest.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Run the accepted source assets, anatomy, genital, creator-tool, DCC, visual, and performance corpora with pinned metrics and exact artifact inspection.
